Marta: :wave: Quick PSA — release cutoff in ~3h. Please double-check your release notes one-liners and format. Use the short template below.

Devon: Got it. Quick question: patch vs minor? We added a small telemetry counter.

Liam: Telemetry-only = patch. Anything user-visible or feature flagged = minor. Breaking = major.

Eva: How long can the one-liners be? We have a slightly longer explanation for the infra change.

Marta: Keep the summary to one sentence (<= 130 chars). Put details in the PR description and link it. Example:

```text
Feature: improve batcher scheduling to cut 99p latency by ~12%
 - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234
 - Component: eng-runtime
 - Notes: rolling deploy required
```

Devon: Nice. Should I tag component with `eng-releases` label or `component/runtime`?

Liam: Use `Component:` field like above, and add labels as usual.

release-bot: Reminder — release cutoff for v0.19.2 is at 2039003600 (3h). If you need an exception, ping @release-eng. :alarm_clock:

Marta: Quick checklist before cutoff:
 - [ ] one-liner <= 130 chars
 - [ ] PR link included
 - [ ] component tag present
 - [ ] author handle in PR
 - [ ] semver classification (patch/minor/major)

Eva: I'll trim ours to a single sentence and paste it here in 15m. :thumbsup:

Devon: dropping the final one-liner here for visibility: `Fix telemetry counter double-increment under load (patch). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1278`

Marta: Awesome — thanks. If anyone needs help phrasing, drop the draft here and I'll nudge. :eyes:
